description: For any five-place relation \(R\) on \(M\), \(\exists a\,\forall x\,\exists b\,\forall z\,\exists c\,R(a,x,b,z,c)\) holds if and only if there are \(d\in M\), \(f:M\to M\), and \(g:M^2\to M\) with \(R(d,x,f(x),z,g(x,z))\) for all \(x,z\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.Skolemization.five_variable_dependencies.{u_1} {M : Type u_1} (R : M → M → M → M → M → Prop) :
  (∃ a, ∀ (x : M), ∃ b, ∀ (z : M), ∃ c, R a x b z c) ↔ ∃ d f g, ∀ (x z : M), R d x (f x) z (g x z)
